text:
maria: deploy-bot blocked `redwood/api:release-2026-03` publish to eu-central-1. Reason: provenance mismatch — manifest digest in attestation doesn't match registry manifest. Anyone around?

deploy-bot: Automated: publish blocked for tag `release-2026-03` (build 7110). Reason: provenance_digest_mismatch. Regions affected: eu-central-1, eu-west-1. Action recommended: retag to prior digest or regenerate attestation.

leo: Quick triage: the build pushed a new multi-arch manifest at 09:01 UTC after the attestation was generated at 08:59 UTC. The attestation points to sha256:deadbeef..., registry manifest is sha256:beefdead... Looks like a post-attestation orphan push.

anya: We're inside the 10:00-11:00 change window. Options: 1) pin to prior digest (fast), 2) re-run attestation and propagate (needs key availability), 3) delay until we reconcile mirrors. I'd prefer pinning to keep canary small.

maria: Agreed. Pin to prior digest in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1; add release-note entry and link to rollback steps. I'll own the approval.

publishbot: Proposed automated steps: create tag `release-2026-03-pin-1833334444`, inject attestation for sha256:deadbeef..., promote to `release-2026-03`. Requires release lead approve.

maria: Approved. Leo, can you run the retag? Share command here.

leo: Running now. Command: ```bash
./tools/ecr-retag --repo redwood/api --from-digest sha256:deadbeef --to-tag release-2026-03 --region eu-central-1
```

publishbot: Retag started. Attestation injection in progress.

publishbot: Retag complete in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1. `release-2026-03` now points to sha256:deadbeef. Attestation verified.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion scheduled in 7m. Routing set to pinned digest for canary hosts; monitor for 20m.

anya: Filing INF-4455 to add a pre-publish check: if attestation timestamp < manifest push timestamp by > 30s, fail CI. Also adding a test to ensure manifest generator doesn't re-push manifests after attest.

maria: PR #960 opened for release notes: "Pin release-2026-03 to prior digest due to post-attestation manifest push". Assigned to @anya for runbook updates.

leo: Note for follow-up: investigate build pipeline step ordering. We should ensure attestation creation is the final step before manifest promotion, or else lock promotion until attestation completes.

anya: Adding runbook entry: during change windows avoid regenerating multi-arch manifests; if necessary, coordinate with release lead.

maria: Summary: retagged to previous digest in affected regions, merged release-note, created INF-4455 and runbook update. Monitoring canary for 30m. Closing thread unless metrics spike. :thumbsup:
